title: Flashscore tennis: matches, live scores, odds, head-to-head and form

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: matches = every match of the days you pick (any past date; the day lists reach 7 days back, older days come from our tennis database), with results, odds, head-to-head, form, Elo and statistics; live = matches in play right now; matchIds = specific matches by id or URL (any date); players = a player's matches, newest first (the whole career from the database, else about 40 recent); rankings = ATP / WTA rankings, one row per player (the latest, the list of a past date, or every weekly list of a date range); tournaments = every match of a tournament edition with its round; playerProfiles = one row per player: age, country, photo, rank, Elo per surface; playerStats = a player's record and serve / return statistics per season, surface, tour or opponent's rank; h2h = two players' head-to-head with every meeting; elo = the Elo list of a tour and surface; sackmann = every played singles match of the seasons in "years" (or the dateFrom..dateTo range; neither = this season) in the columns of Jeff Sackmann's atp_matches / wta_matches CSV files: winner and loser, rank at the time, age, score, round, minutes, serve statistics (tours: ATP and WTA unless set); playerList = every ATP and / or WTA player (from "Ranking lists") with ids and names, plus playing hand, birth date, height and country where known, in the columns of Jeff Sackmann's atp_players / wta_players files.
enumTitles: Match CSV in Jeff Sackmann's tennis_atp format
Player list (ids, names, hand, height, country)

sackmannFile.title: Sackmann file
sackmannFile.description: sackmann mode: which file to write, in the column layout of Jeff Sackmann's tennis files. matches = played matches of the seasons or dates (Closing odds adds the bookmakers' prices); upcoming = today's and tomorrow's scheduled singles with both players' rank, seed, Elo and the Elo win probability; new-results = the matches that finished since your last run with the same tours, each once, usually complete with statistics and Elo (schedule it daily, at least weekly; the first run returns today and the 10 days before); rankings = every weekly ATP / WTA list of the seasons or dates (Top ranks only keeps the top); players = the ATP / WTA player list; pointbypoint = one row per finished match with every point. Matches, upcoming and new results are charged as match rows, rankings as ranking rows, players as player-list rows and point by point at the point-by-point price (see Pricing).
enumTitles: New results since the last run

closingOdds.title: Closing odds
closingOdds.description: sackmann mode, played matches file: adds each match's closing odds from the bookmakers of the country set in Bookmakers of country, in tennis-data.co.uk's columns, winner (W) and loser (L): B365W / B365L (bet365), MaxW / MaxL (best price), AvgW / AvgL (average), OpenAvgW / OpenAvgL (average opening price), ProbW / ProbL (win probability without the bookmaker margin), BookmakerCount and OddsCountry. Charged as bookmaker odds, only for the matches that have odds (see Pricing).

pointByPointFormat.title: Point-by-point layout
pointByPointFormat.description: With Point by point on, in the match modes: games = each match row carries its games (server, winner, breaks, the points in order); sackmann = one row per finished match, in any match mode (matches, matchIds, players, tournaments), in the layout of Jeff Sackmann's tennis_pointbypoint files (pbp_id, server1, server2, the whole match as one S/R string, score, minutes), ready for the tools built on them. Each string is checked point by point against the final score. Sackmann rows are charged as point-by-point only, with no match row. (Whole seasons in this layout: sackmann mode, Sackmann file = Point by point.)

dateFrom.title: From day (UTC)
dateFrom.description: Matches mode: the first day, in UTC. today, yesterday, tomorrow, a date like 2026-09-28, or an offset like -3 (three days ago) or +1. Flashscore's daily lists go 7 days back; days ahead list what is already scheduled (usually 1-2 days).

dateTo.title: To day (UTC)
dateTo.description: Matches mode: the last day, inclusive, same formats as From day. Empty = only the From day. Example: From -7 and To today = the last 8 days.

matchIds.title: Match ids or URLs
matchIds.description: matchIds mode: Flashscore match ids (the 8 characters after mid= or /match/, e.g. llKI871b) or full match URLs. Any date, also older than 7 days. Adds the round (e.g. Final) and the match duration.

playerUrls.title: Players (names or URLs)
playerUrls.description: players, playerProfiles, playerStats and h2h modes: player names, e.g. "Jannik Sinner" or "Swiatek" (the best-known player of that name), or Flashscore player page URLs, e.g. https://www.flashscore.com/player/sinner-jannik/6HdC3z4H/, to pick one exactly. h2h mode takes them in pairs: 1st v 2nd, 3rd v 4th...

rankingLists.title: Ranking lists
rankingLists.description: rankings mode: which lists. Each has about 2,000 players (top 100 in one request, the rest in a second one). playerList mode: atp and / or wta.

rankingDate.title: Ranking date
rankingDate.description: rankings mode: the list of this date (YYYY-MM-DD; ATP back to 1973, WTA back to 2001); empty = the latest list.

rankingDateTo.title: Ranking date to
rankingDateTo.description: rankings mode: with a ranking date, every weekly list from that date up to this one (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty = just the one list.

maxRank.title: Top ranks only
maxRank.description: rankings mode and the Sackmann rankings file: only players ranked this high or better, e.g. 100 for the top 100. Empty = everyone.

rankingFormat.title: Rankings layout
rankingFormat.description: standard = one row per player with rank, points and movement; sackmann = the columns of Jeff Sackmann's rankings files (date, rank, player, points).

tournamentUrls.title: Tournament URLs
tournamentUrls.description: tournaments mode: Flashscore tournament URLs, e.g. https://www.flashscore.com/tennis/atp-singles/wimbledon/ (or an edition: .../wimbledon-2019/).

years.title: Years
years.description: tournaments mode: the editions to read, e.g. [2019, 2023]; empty = the latest edition. sackmann mode: the seasons, e.g. [2024, 2025] (from 1990).

statsSplitBy.title: Statistics split
statsSplitBy.description: playerStats mode: one row per season, surface, tour, opponent's rank band (top 10, 11-50, 51-100, 101-250, 251+) or all matches together.

eloTour.title: Elo tour
eloTour.description: elo mode: men (ATP, Challenger, ITF) or women (WTA, Challenger, ITF).

eloSurface.title: Elo surface
eloSurface.description: elo mode: overall Elo or Elo on one surface.

tours.title: Tours
tours.description: Keep only these tours. Empty = all. challenger-women is the WTA 125 level; teams = Davis Cup, Billie Jean King Cup, Laver Cup ties; other = exhibitions, juniors and the rest.

matchType.title: Singles or doubles
matchType.description: singles (default), doubles (includes mixed doubles), or all (also team ties).

status.title: Status
status.description: all, scheduled (not started, delayed, postponed), live (in play), finished (including retired, walkover and awarded).

tournaments.title: Tournament name contains
tournaments.description: Keep matches whose tournament name or category contains any of these, case-insensitive, e.g. Beijing, US Open, W100, Challenger.

players.title: Player name contains
players.description: Keep matches with a player whose name contains any of these, case-insensitive (Flashscore writes names as "Sinner J."): Sinner, Swiatek. A player id also works.

surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.description: Keep matches on these surfaces. Empty = all. Matches without a surface (team ties) are dropped when this is set.

includeOdds.title: Bookmaker odds
includeOdds.description: Match-winner odds of each bookmaker (current and opening; closing odds for finished matches), best and average price, win probability without the bookmaker margin, and a link to each bookmaker. Charged per match that has odds (see Pricing).

oddsCountry.title: Bookmakers of country
oddsCountry.description: Bookmakers differ by country (licences). Two-letter code: GB (about 20 bookmakers: bet365, William Hill, Betfair, Sky Bet, Paddy Power...), DE, PL, IT, ES, FR, US, AU, NG and others.

oddsMarkets.title: Odds markets
oddsMarkets.description: match-winner = the summary and one row per bookmaker; all = also every other market in oddsMarkets: set winner, total games and sets, game and set handicaps, correct score (about 100-200 prices per match).

includeH2H.title: Head-to-head, form and fatigue
includeH2H.description: Head-to-head record (all surfaces and this surface, last 5 meetings), each player's last 10 results, win % overall and on this surface, days since the last match, matches and sets in the last 7 and 14 days, and whether they retired in their last match. Computed as of the match start. Charged per match (see Pricing).

includeStatistics.title: Match statistics
includeStatistics.description: Serve and return statistics for matches that started: aces, double faults, 1st serve %, points won on 1st / 2nd serve, break points saved and converted, service and return games won, for the match and each set. Included in the base price.

includePointByPoint.title: Point by point
includePointByPoint.description: Every game of matches that started: server, winner, breaks, the points in order and break / set / match points. Charged per match (see Pricing).

includeRankings.title: Player rankings
includeRankings.description: Current ATP / WTA singles rank and points of each player (singles matches). Two small requests per list per run.

sortBy.title: Order
sortBy.description: tour = ATP first, then WTA, Challenger, ITF, each by start time; time = by start time only. Players mode is always newest first.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Maximum records to return (matches or ranking rows), counted after the filters. A busy day has 300-450 singles matches across all tours.
